lesson: Fast inserters in 2.0 support filters (configure filter=item): use them to share one belt between two items, one per lane via sideloads.
context: ops: @serf Transport Belt Madness, level 3 of 5, on this island. 6 input chests each need a belt to the output chest with the same item. Belt starts and ends: iron-plate: [gps=-12.5,-1.5] to [gps=13.5,2.5]; copper-plate: [gps=-12.5,-0.5] to [gps=13.5,4.5]; iron-gear-wheel: [gps=-12.5,0.5] to [gps=13.5,3.5]; steel-plate: [gps=-12.5,2.5] to [gps=13.5,-1.5]; coal: [gps=-12.5,3.5] to [gps=13.5,0.5]; electronic-circuit: [gps=-12.5,4.5] to [gps=13.5,-0.5]. Belts can't cross: go under with underground belts, and no item may ever reach the wrong chest (that fails the level and resets it). You have 300 transport-belt, 60 underground-belt; that's all there is. The inserters start by themselves once every input's belt reaches an output chest. Done when every output chest holds 21 of its item.
ops: @serf Every input's belt reaches an output chest, so the inserters are on. Watch the output chests fill to 21.
ops: @serf Level solved: every output chest holds 21 of its item (143 belts and undergrounds placed).
